name: Tag
purpose: Compact label for status, category or metadata (Live, Final, Sold out, Division A). Optionally removable for active filters.

props.name: tone
props.description: Semantic color. Status tones add a default icon.

props.name: removeLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the remove button (default 'Remove <text>').

states.name: removable
states.description: Has a remove button with hover and focus states.

accessibility.role: Static text (no role); remove control is a button

keyboard.action: Focus the remove button (removable tags only).

screenReader: Read as plain text in context.
After removal, move focus to the next tag or the related input.
accessibility.focus: Only the remove button receives focus.
accessibility.touchTarget: Remove button hit area is 44px on touch.
notes: All tone/variant combinations pass 4.5:1 in both modes (verified by check:contrast).

variants.name: subtle
variants.useWhen: Default for status in tables and cards.

do: Use status tones consistently (success=complete, warning=attention, danger=problem).
Use removable tags to show active filters.
dont: Don't make tags clickable links or buttons; use Button or Link.
Don't rely on tone color alone to convey meaning.

example.web:
<Tag tone="success">Final</Tag>
<Tag tone="danger" variant="solid" icon="alert-circle">Live</Tag>
<Tag onRemove={() => removeFilter('u12')}>Under 12</Tag>
